messages.author: d5124cd091a46db4
messages.subject: Shinyapps.io monitoring
parts:
Hi,

Do you have any recommentaion for a website monitoring? How can I know if Shinyapps.io has failed to load my app?

Best regards,

Avner

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Shinyapps.io monitoring
parts:
Avner,

You could use a monitoring system such as Pingdom. However I would advise against it. The reason is that when applications running on shinyapps.io are not in use (e.g. have had 0 connections for 15 minutes), they go to sleep. While application are asleep, they do not use active hours. A web monitoring system such as Pingdom, will make periodic requests to the application to check if its up or not. This will have the effect of waking the application up and it consume hours even though no real person is using it.

-Andy
